events.title: Qwen3.8-27B open weights released — 27.8B dense multimodal, 262K native context, Apache 2.0
events.title_zh: Qwen3.8-27B 开放权重——27.8B 稠密多模态，原生 262K 上下文，Apache 2.0 协议
events.summary: Alibaba released open weights of Qwen3.8-27B, the open sibling of the Qwen3.8 family promised at the Aug 3 Qwen3.8-Max launch. Dense 27.8B vision-language model with hybrid attention (Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention), 262,144-token native context extensible to 1M via YaRN, image+video+text input, Apache 2.0. Thinking on by default with reasoning_effort control (xhigh/medium/low).
events.why_it_matters: Frontier-adjacent agentic + multimodal capability in a single-GPU-class open model under Apache 2.0 — the leading candidate default local/self-hosted coding-agent base model for this cycle.
events.summary_zh: Alibaba 发布 Qwen3.8-27B 开源权重，即 8 月 3 日 Qwen3.8-Max 发布时承诺的 Qwen3.8 家族开源版本。27.8B dense 视觉语言模型，采用混合注意力（Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention），原生 262,144 token 上下文、可经 YaRN 扩展至 1M，支持图像+视频+文本输入，Apache 2.0 协议。默认开启 thinking，支持 reasoning_effort 控制（xhigh/medium/low）。
events.summary_en: Alibaba released open weights of Qwen3.8-27B, the open sibling of the Qwen3.8 family promised at the Aug 3 Qwen3.8-Max launch. Dense 27.8B vision-language model with hybrid attention (Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention), 262,144-token native context extensible to 1M via YaRN, image+video+text input, Apache 2.0. Thinking on by default with reasoning_effort control (xhigh/medium/low).
events.why_it_matters_zh: 在 Apache 2.0 下，单卡级开源模型具备了接近 frontier 的 agentic + 多模态能力——这是本周期本地/自托管 coding agent 基座模型的首选候选。
events.why_it_matters_en: Frontier-adjacent agentic + multimodal capability in a single-GPU-class open model under Apache 2.0 — the leading candidate default local/self-hosted coding-agent base model for this cycle.

technical_details.architecture: 64 layers; 16 x (3 x (Gated DeltaNet -> FFN) -> 1 x (Gated Attention -> FFN)); MTP trained; architecture family qwen3_5
technical_details.adoption: 91,917 downloads + 9,479 likes on HF within ~1 day; 319 community quantizations; Ollama day-0 support (v0.32.12/v0.32.13 on Aug 14); OpenRouter $0.45/$3.20 per Mtok

technical_details_zh.架构: 64 层；16 ×（3 ×（Gated DeltaNet → FFN）→ 1 ×（Gated Attention → FFN））；MTP 训练；架构族 qwen3_5

events.title: Zhipu (Z.ai) releases GLM-5.3 — claims strongest open-weights coding model; weights deferred ~2 weeks for security review
events.title_zh: 智谱（Z.ai）发布 GLM-5.3——号称最强开放权重编程模型；权重因安全审查推迟约 2 周
events.summary: Zhipu released GLM-5.3, built on the same base as GLM-5.2 with all gains from post-training ('scaling post-training is all we did'). Positioned as strongest open-weights coding model with heavy cybersecurity/agentic focus: worked with Chinese security teams to find 2,436 vulnerabilities across 269 projects, published in public registry cvd.z.ai. Available immediately via GLM Coding Plan (works with Claude Code, OpenCode); API 'coming soon'; open weights in ~2 weeks after security reviews.
events.why_it_matters: Post-training-only release claiming open-weights coding SOTA and leading CyberGym over US frontier models — a data point that post-training scaling can move agentic/coding capability substantially; the deferred-weights-after-security-review pattern is itself notable.
events.summary_zh: 智谱发布 GLM-5.3，与 GLM-5.2 同一基座，全部提升来自 post-training（官方称「scaling post-training 是我们唯一做的事」）。定位为最强开源权重 coding 模型，重点投入网络安全/agentic 能力：与中国安全团队合作在 269 个项目中发现 2,436 个漏洞，公开登记于 cvd.z.ai。现已通过 GLM Coding Plan 提供（兼容 Claude Code、OpenCode）；API 「即将上线」；开源权重预计在约 2 周的安全审查后发布。
events.summary_en: Zhipu released GLM-5.3, built on the same base as GLM-5.2 with all gains from post-training ('scaling post-training is all we did'). Positioned as strongest open-weights coding model with heavy cybersecurity/agentic focus: worked with Chinese security teams to find 2,436 vulnerabilities across 269 projects, published in public registry cvd.z.ai. Available immediately via GLM Coding Plan (works with Claude Code, OpenCode); API 'coming soon'; open weights in ~2 weeks after security reviews.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 仅靠 post-training 就号称拿下开源权重 coding SOTA、并在 CyberGym 上超过美国 frontier 模型——这是一个数据点，说明 post-training scaling 能显著推动 agentic/coding 能力；「安全审查后再放权重」的模式本身也值得关注。
events.why_it_matters_en: Post-training-only release claiming open-weights coding SOTA and leading CyberGym over US frontier models — a data point that post-training scaling can move agentic/coding capability substantially; the deferred-weights-after-security-review pattern is itself notable.

technical_details.weights: open-source planned ~2 weeks after security review (approx 2026-08-28)

events.update_2026_08_15: Z.ai published follow-up 'Preparing GLM-5.3 for Open Release: A Responsible Path to Cyber Defense' at 2026-08-15T06:32Z, plus live OpenVuln demo space (huggingface.co/spaces/zai-org/OpenVuln). Reaffirms weights-after-review plan.

technical_details_zh.发现漏洞: 覆盖 269 个项目共 2,436 个（注册库：cvd.z.ai）
technical_details_zh.权重: 计划安全审查后约 2 周开源（约 2026-08-28）

events.title: Cloudflare ships MCP traffic detection and enforcement in Cloudflare One Gateway
events.title_zh: Cloudflare One Gateway 上线 MCP 流量检测与管控
events.summary: Cloudflare added first-class identification, monitoring, and control of MCP traffic to its Zero Trust Gateway, targeting shadow-MCP discovery and blocking of unapproved servers. Detection keys on the MCP-Protocol-Version HTTP header (required by MCP 2025-11-25 spec; on every POST in the 2026-07-28 stateless spec, which adds Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name). New experimental.is_mcp boolean selector for all Zero Trust customers; dedicated MCP dashboard; Portal-only enforcement via Traffic Source selectors; MCP Portals support pre-registered OAuth clients; Agents SDK v0.20.0 supports the stateless 2026-07-28 spec as client and server.
events.why_it_matters: First widely deployed network-level enforcement primitive for MCP — security teams can discover and block shadow MCP servers without maintaining domain lists. Addresses a top enterprise blocker for agent rollout.
events.summary_zh: Cloudflare 在其 Zero Trust Gateway 中加入对 MCP 流量的一等识别、监控与管控，目标是发现 shadow-MCP 并阻断未经批准的服务器。检测基于 MCP-Protocol-Version HTTP header（MCP 2025-11-25 规范要求携带；2026-07-28 无状态规范中每个 POST 都带，并新增 Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name）。新增 experimental.is_mcp 布尔选择器，面向全部 Zero Trust 客户；独立 MCP dashboard；通过 Traffic Source 选择器实现仅放行 Portal 的管控；MCP Portals 支持预注册 OAuth client；Agents SDK v0.20.0 作为 client 和 server 均支持 2026-07-28 无状态规范。
events.summary_en: Cloudflare added first-class identification, monitoring, and control of MCP traffic to its Zero Trust Gateway, targeting shadow-MCP discovery and blocking of unapproved servers. Detection keys on the MCP-Protocol-Version HTTP header (required by MCP 2025-11-25 spec; on every POST in the 2026-07-28 stateless spec, which adds Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name). New experimental.is_mcp boolean selector for all Zero Trust customers; dedicated MCP dashboard; Portal-only enforcement via Traffic Source selectors; MCP Portals support pre-registered OAuth clients; Agents SDK v0.20.0 supports the stateless 2026-07-28 spec as client and server.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这是首个广泛部署的 MCP 网络层管控原语——安全团队无需维护域名清单即可发现并阻断 shadow MCP server，解决了企业落地 agent 的一个主要阻碍。
events.why_it_matters_en: First widely deployed network-level enforcement primitive for MCP — security teams can discover and block shadow MCP servers without maintaining domain lists. Addresses a top enterprise blocker for agent rollout.

technical_details.detection: MCP-Protocol-Version HTTP header on TLS-decrypted requests
technical_details.dashboard: requests, unique users/servers, Portal vs direct split, top shadow servers
technical_details.enforcement: Traffic Source selectors; baseline rule blocks non-mcp_portal MCP
technical_details.agents_sdk: v0.20.0 — stateless 2026-07-28 spec client+server support, createMcpHandler in Workers

technical_details_zh.仪表盘: 请求量、独立用户/服务器数、Portal 与直连占比、top 影子服务器
technical_details_zh.管控: Traffic Source 选择器；基线规则拦截非 mcp_portal 的 MCP 流量
technical_details_zh.Agents SDK: v0.20.0——支持 2026-07-28 无状态规范的 client+server，Workers 内置 createMcpHandler
technical_details_zh.前提: Gateway 需开启 TLS 解密

events.title: Claude Code 2.1.232–2.1.238 — subagent forking default-on, cross-session agent messaging, sandbox resource limits
events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.232–2.1.238——subagent fork 默认开启、跨会话 agent 消息、sandbox 资源限额
events.published_at_note: 2.1.232 dated 2026-08-13, 2.1.233 dated 2026-08-14 (GitHub release 22:20Z), 2.1.234 dated 2026-08-17 in official changelog.
events.summary: Two rapid-fire Claude Code releases turn it toward multi-agent operation: subagent forking on by default ('fork' subagent inherits full conversation + prompt cache; non-teammate agent spawns run in background), cross-session agent-to-agent messaging via @-mentions (SendMessage to named live sessions, v2.1.224+, local sockets, messages only), GitLab MR support + plugin marketplaces, secret redaction, multiple security fixes (PowerShell $PSDefaultParameterValues overwrite, Cygwin symlink bypass, nested-git-repo trust inheritance, /tmp socket hardening). 2.1.233 adds cgroup memory limits for sandboxed Bash (CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT), opt-in forward_user_identity gateway spend attribution, MCP v2 reconnect fix; todo tools removed for Opus 4.8/Sonnet 5/Fable 5/Mythos 5+.
events.why_it_matters: Default-on forking plus native inter-session messaging makes Claude Code a de facto local multi-agent runtime; resource-limited sandboxed execution and per-user spend attribution are enterprise-blocking features now landing.
events.summary_zh: 连续两个 Claude Code 版本将其推向多 agent 形态：subagent forking 默认开启（fork 出的 subagent 继承完整会话和 prompt cache；非 teammate 的 agent 在后台启动），通过 @-mention 实现跨会话 agent 间消息（向指定存活会话 SendMessage，v2.1.224+，基于本地 socket，仅传消息），GitLab MR 支持 + plugin marketplace，secret 脱敏，多项安全修复（PowerShell $PSDefaultParameterValues 覆写、Cygwin symlink 绕过、嵌套 git 仓库信任继承、/tmp socket 加固）。2.1.233 新增 sandbox Bash 的 cgroup 内存限制（CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT）、可选开启的 forward_user_identity 网关花费归因、MCP v2 重连修复；Opus 4.8/Sonnet 5/Fable 5/Mythos 5+ 移除 todo 工具。
events.summary_en: Two rapid-fire Claude Code releases turn it toward multi-agent operation: subagent forking on by default ('fork' subagent inherits full conversation + prompt cache; non-teammate agent spawns run in background), cross-session agent-to-agent messaging via @-mentions (SendMessage to named live sessions, v2.1.224+, local sockets, messages only), GitLab MR support + plugin marketplaces, secret redaction, multiple security fixes (PowerShell $PSDefaultParameterValues overwrite, Cygwin symlink bypass, nested-git-repo trust inheritance, /tmp socket hardening). 2.1.233 adds cgroup memory limits for sandboxed Bash (CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT), opt-in forward_user_identity gateway spend attribution, MCP v2 reconnect fix; todo tools removed for Opus 4.8/Sonnet 5/Fable 5/Mythos 5+.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 默认开启 forking 加上原生跨会话消息，使 Claude Code 成为事实上的本地 multi-agent runtime；带资源限制的沙箱执行和按用户的花费归因正是企业落地的阻塞项，如今开始补齐。
events.why_it_matters_en: Default-on forking plus native inter-session messaging makes Claude Code a de facto local multi-agent runtime; resource-limited sandboxed execution and per-user spend attribution are enterprise-blocking features now landing.

technical_details.forking: default on; inherits conversation + prompt cache
technical_details.messaging: SendMessage via @-mentions across live sessions; no history/files/permissions exchange
technical_details.breaking: todo tools disabled by default on newer models

events.update_2026_08_17: 2.1.234 (2026-08-17, in-window): rejects Windows NT-namespace (\??\) paths across remote file reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts and uploads — hardens pre-approval file accesses against the NTLM credential-leak vector; GitLab MR footer badge (draft/pending/green states, glab repos); auto-continue sessions when usage limit resets (toggle in /config); claude-api skill context cost cut from ~200k+ to ~25k tokens; selection:clear keybinding; CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME env var; many Remote Control / permission-preview / TUI fixes.
events.update_2026_08_18: 2.1.235 (2026-08-18, in-window): security-relevant fix — Shift+Tab in the permission prompt's comment field no longer wrongly grants session-wide edit permission; new optional `spellcheck` setting (aspell/hunspell/ispell); fix for whole-prompt-cache invalidation when a language server disconnects mid-session; nested markdown list misalignment fix (depth 3+); lower memory/CPU usage for background cloud sessions (/ultrareview); permission dialogs now display exactly what a grant covers; VS Code focus fix after window restore. Recommendation stays ADOPT; upgrading also picks up the 2.1.234 NTLM hardening.
events.update_2026_08_19: 2.1.236 (2026-08-19, in-window): `notify_when_idle` option added to cross-session SendMessage — one session can request a single notice when another goes idle (macOS/Linux), extending the inter-agent messaging primitive with idle-awareness; new ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL env var sets the starting model for new sessions (/model pick still overrides and persists); macOS sandbox hardening — wildcard read-deny rules like **/.env now take precedence inside allowed regions and resist rename-based bypass; /goal idle sessions auto-check-in after 30 minutes behind long background work; /usage gains a usage-credits row (Team/Enterprise); fixes: clipboard/background tasks breaking after session-directory removal, fullscreen renderer permanently failing after one bad start, /model picker overflow on tall terminals, various fullscreen/tmux rendering issues. Recommendation stays ADOPT.

technical_details_zh.fork: 默认开启；继承会话与 prompt cache
technical_details_zh.消息: 通过 @-mentions 跨实时会话 SendMessage；不交换历史/文件/权限
technical_details_zh.破坏性变更: 新模型默认停用 todo 工具

events.update_2026_08_20: 2.1.237 + 2.1.238 (both 2026-08-20, in-window). 2.1.237: fixed prompt caching for sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL (directly relevant to gateway deployments); added a built-in 'Concise' output style ('Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration') selectable via /config. 2.1.238: fixed unbounded memory growth in long interactive sessions — subagent tool results are now freed after leaving the recent display window, directly relevant to long-running multi-agent sessions; plugin marketplaces gained `headersHelper` for URL marketplaces/catalog entries (mints short-lived HTTP headers such as tokens for catalog and same-origin archive fetches, shown to the user first with [y/N] confirmation, no inherited credential env vars) — private/enterprise plugin distribution; self-hosted runner `--defer-shutdown-max-min` (keep serving attached sessions on SIGTERM, then park and exit) and `--proxy-authorization-command`/`--proxy-authorization-file` for proxies needing a fresh Proxy-Authorization header per connection; numerous Remote Control fixes (mid-turn messages vanishing from transcripts, model picks on phone/web not updating the terminal, 'login expired' on brief network hiccups now retries, crashed-session reuse, env-var leaks, per-task Stop, ListAgents/SendMessage wrongly reporting 'not connected' in server mode); cross-session messaging hardening (refused inboxes now report 'refused'; rate-limited/dropped messages notify the sender instead of vanishing); MCP fixes (stdio servers no longer receive server/discover before initialize — lazy servers no longer start on every open; elicitation dialogs fixed for URLs over 4,096 chars; disabled servers listed without health-checking). Recommendation stays ADOPT.

events.title: DeepSeek open-sources Harness (dsh) — MIT TypeScript agent runtime, extreme star velocity
events.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源 Harness（dsh）——MIT 协议的 TypeScript agent 运行时，star 增速极快
events.published_at_note: Exact open-source release date community-reported only (~Aug 13/14; v0.1 with 24k+ stars within a day per roundup of 2026-08-14T21:21Z). Repo pre-existed (referenced in DeepSeek changelog 2026-07-31 as forthcoming).
events.summary: DeepSeek released its agent harness (the framework behind its benchmark runs) as open source under MIT — a TypeScript/Node monorepo built on the Cordis framework with an everything-is-a-plugin architecture, positioned as an open challenge to Claude Code. Runs via npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web (Web UI at 127.0.0.1:3080); AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md-compatible config; developer preview with explicit breaking-change warnings.
events.why_it_matters: A frontier lab releasing its production agent runtime under MIT gives agent engineers a first-party reference implementation of DeepSeek's agent loop and a new harness option; expect preview churn.
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 将其 agent harness（跑 benchmark 所用的框架）以 MIT 协议开源——基于 Cordis 框架的 TypeScript/Node monorepo，采用 everything-is-a-plugin 架构，被视为对 Claude Code 的公开挑战。通过 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 运行（Web UI 位于 127.0.0.1:3080）；兼容 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 配置；当前为 developer preview，官方明确警告会有 breaking change。

events.title: SpaceX's $60B acquisition of Cursor (Anysphere) officially closes
events.title_zh: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor（Anysphere）正式完成交割
